breaking_news.headline: More people are juggling work and kids -- and finding they can't give 100% to both
breaking_news.summary: A new Pew survey finds many working parents feel they cannot give 100% at either work or home. Benefits like paid sick leave and more affordable childcare could help.

breaking_news.headline: The war with Iran is making oil changes pricier. And a deal won't solve it
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. may be the world's biggest producer of crude oil, but that's not the case for motor oil. The cost of lubricants is soaring, and even a tentative deal to end the war won't solve the problem.

breaking_news.headline: Shipping exec says industry needs assurances Strait of Hormuz will be safe
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with Jakob Larsen, chief safety and security officer at BIMCO, the global shipping association, about what it might mean to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

breaking_news.headline: Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady and hints at rate hike later this year
breaking_news.summary: The Federal Reserve left its benchmark interest rates unchanged Wednesday, and signaled its next move could be a rate increase. It's the first rate decision under the new Fed chairman, Kevin Warsh.

breaking_news.headline: With Iran deal, Trump told ships to 'start your engines.' That's not happening yet
breaking_news.summary: Iran's control of the Strait of Hormuz inflicted global pain during the months-long conflict with the U.S. and Israel. A tentative deal is in place, but questions remain about the key waterway.

breaking_news.headline: Here's how much the Iran war cost -- and how its effects will linger
breaking_news.summary: More than three months after the U.S. and Israel launched their war on Iran, the costs and aftereffects are felt around the world.

breaking_news.headline: Poll: Most Americans have the summer blues about Trump and the economy
breaking_news.summary: A new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll finds a record low share of Americans approve of President Trump's job performance and his handling of the economy heading into the summer before a key midterm election.

breaking_news.headline: Here is how SpaceX could turn up in your current investments
breaking_news.summary: SpaceX stock hit the market last week. Here's how it could turn up in your retirement or investment portfolio.

breaking_news.headline: Israeli strikes kill six people in Gaza including Al Jazeera cameraman, officials say
breaking_news.summary: The Israeli military accused Ahmed Wishah of being a "Hamas sniper operative", without providing evidence.

breaking_news.headline: Tight security as Indian students resit medical exam after alleged paper leak
breaking_news.summary: Millions of candidates face biometric checks and frisking as air force deployed to secure exam papers.

breaking_news.headline: Former Olympian denies vandalising Washington Reflecting Pool after arrest
breaking_news.summary: Davey Hearn says he was simply touching the new paint at the site out of curiosity and did not remove or alter it.

breaking_news.headline: Colombia's escalating, brutal internal conflict is defining its presidential election
breaking_news.summary: A left-wing senator who backs talks with armed gangs faces an outsider endorsed by Trump.

breaking_news.headline: Half of France under red heat alert as alcohol banned at street music festival
breaking_news.summary: Temperatures are forecast to peak on Monday, and authorities warn they could match historic highs.

breaking_news.headline: Ethiopia PM's party wins landslide as fears grow of new conflict
breaking_news.summary: Abiy Ahmed's party retains its huge majority despite unrest in several parts of Ethiopia and tensions with its neighbours.

breaking_news.headline: Fuel sales halted in occupied Crimea as Ukraine targets oil facilities
breaking_news.summary: Fuel had already been rationed due to shortages caused by Kyiv's attacks against supply routes in Russian-occupied territories.

breaking_news.headline: Trump and Iran's negotiator trade warnings as talks held in Switzerland
breaking_news.summary: The US president, who is not at the talks, threatens to attack Iran if it does not restrain Hezbollah in Lebanon.

breaking_news.headline: Interest rates held as Bank warns of impact of high energy prices
breaking_news.summary: The Bank last cut interest rates in December but upheaval in the Middle East has stalled any further reductions.

breaking_news.headline: Five ways the Iran peace deal could affect you and your money
breaking_news.summary: With fuel and gas prices having fallen in recent days, we look at how the end of hostilities might affect you - in five charts.

breaking_news.headline: The artificial ice pyramids saving India's mountain villages
breaking_news.summary: Himalayan villages are creating artificial glaciers to guarantee water for their crops in the spring.

breaking_news.headline: Brexit cost 6% of UK economy, Bank of England company data suggests
breaking_news.summary: Analysis showed how much the UK could have grown if it had not exited the EU.
